transcript.text: Could you make a clip that starts with a dark green title card with cream lettering, then cuts to a slow moving shot of a misty mountain lake at sunrise? I’ve been craving a little moment of calm, which is why this idea appeals to me. The title should say exactly “A quieter kind of morning,” with that capitalization and without the quotation marks or the comma, and stay on screen for the first 2 seconds. The whole clip should be 6 seconds long, in 16:9 widescreen, and completely silent. I’m probably over-explaining because I’m excited about how peaceful it could feel. Please don’t include any other text; the title’s font and layout are your call.

Your clip is ready: http://127.0.0.1:8000/films/4d36004426e84bb9aaeb15f2ad5e4af6.mp4

- 0–2 s: a dark green title card (#1F3D2B) that says "A quieter kind of morning". The card was drawn by code, not by the AI, so the words are exactly as you wrote them.
- 2–6 s: a slow glide over a misty mountain lake at sunrise, with mist moving on the still water.
- 16:9 (854×480, the free plan's 480p). It has no sound and runs 6.1 s.

Two things I could not confirm:
- The card tool lets me set the background colour but not the text colour, so I can't promise the letters are cream. Please check, and tell me if they came out a different colour.
- I also couldn't watch the lake shot. I told the model to put no text in it, but please check that none appeared.

The lake shot used 96 credits. The card was free.
transcript.why: The reply presents a finished result: a link to a 6.1 s, 854×480 MP4 with a described title card and lake shot. It includes caveats about text colour and the unverified lake shot, but the core output is delivered and it asks the user only to check, not to choose or approve.
